findings.issue: Hithpael sequential 3mp of H2398 is the self-cleansing stem, not qal commission of sin. «se pecaron» keeps a reflexive marker but uses «pecar», adding that the Levites sinned and dropping the hithpael cleansing force.

notes: The other clauses match person, number, objects, cognate תְּנוּפָה, and Jehová.
